buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms.

2. Generic Bidder financial standing: The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar proceedings, should not be bankrupt. Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid. 3. Generic Bidders are advised to check applicable GST on their own before quoting. Buyer will not take any responsibility in this regards. GST reimbursement will be as per actuals or as per applicable rates (whichever is lower), subject to the maximum of quoted GST %. 4. Generic Experience Criteria: The Bidder or its OEM {themselves or through reseller(s)} should have regularly, manufactured and supplied same or similar Category Products to any Central / State Govt Organization / PSU for 3 years before the bid opening date. Copies of relevant contracts to be submitted along with bid in support of having supplied some quantity during each of the year. In case of bunch bids, the primary product having highest value should meet this criterion. 5. Generic Manufacturer Authorization:Wherever Authorised Distributors/service providers are submitting the bid, Authorisation Form /Certificate with OEM/Original Service Provider details such as name, designation, address, e-mail Id and Phone No. required to be furnished along with the bid 6. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Only supply of Goods 7. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 8. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Additional terms & conditions Mandatory requirements from the bidders. A bid will be disqualified if any of the criteria provided in follo wing points are not fulfilled: 1. Bidder should be original equipment Manufacturer (OEM/ Reseller) 2. An undertaking from the OEM/ reseller is required stating that they would facilitate regular basis with technology/ product updates and extend all support for the warranty in confirmation with this tender for the quoted items. 3. Non- compliance of tender terms, non- uploading of required documents, lack of clarity of t he specifications, contradiction &supporting literature etc. may lead to rejection. 4. A notarized affidavit by the bidder that has never been blacklisted by any Govt. Depart ment & funded autonomous bodies must be uploaded along with the technical bid, failing wh ich the bid shall be rejected. The original affidavit shall be submitted before the award of the bid by the lowest evaluated successful OEM. 5. Certified Financial Statement of OEM from a CA such as Balance Sheets and Profit and loss statements for the last 3 Financial years will be required to be provided in the bid accor ding to following details, the average annual turnover of the OEM should be more than 50 Cr ores (CA Certificate with UIDAI no. must be uploaded) 6. The product warranty will be one year from the manufacturing defect. 7. Third party feasibility report for list of machinery required to be uploaded like for CNC She ering M/C capacity 06-16 mm, CNC Turret Punching with Servo drive, CNC laser cut M/c, Motori zed pie bending machine, Panel Saw machine, manual edge bending machine, through feed e dge bending machine, Spindle Molder with auto feeder etc and furniture testing equipment’s in stalled in the factory. 8. Adherence to all specifications is compulsory. 9. Escalation Matrix for Service support. OEM must provide escalation matrix with tel ephone nos. for service support. 10. If OEM/Bidder is MSME unit, they should provide ZED -GOLD certificate.

OR If OEM/Bidder is a large-scale unit they should provide IEM certificate. 11. The OEM should have BIS License for manufacturing furniture as per follow ings which will be verified from BIS website: - a) IS:17631: 2022 b) IS17632 : 2022 c) IS:17633 :2022 d) IS17634 : 2022 e) IS17635 : 2022 12. The Manufacturer's employees should have completed the welding trainin g program as per ISO 14731 and hold a proficiency certificate from the Institut e of Welding & Testing Technology. All relevant documents w.r.t above points must be uploaded with tender documents. SPECIAL CONDITIONS 1. GENERAL 1.1 The following special conditions shall be read in conjunction with General Conditions of Co ntract IAFW-1815-Z, IAFW-1815(R) and addenda there to. Any provision in these special conditions, if at va riance with the provision contained in the above mentioned documents, the provision in these special cond itions shall be deemed to take precedence there over. 1. PLACE OF DELIVERY OF SUPPLY 2.1 The items of f urniture enumerated in Bid shall be supplied to furniture yard for inspection of BOO and then taken over b y MES as directed by GE. 3. INSPECTION OF FURNITURE AT CONTRACTOR’S WORKSHOP. 3.1 The GE and/or Engineer-in-Charge shall inspect the articles of furniture during the process of manufacturing at the contra ctor’s workshop time to time and particularly at the following stages, for which proper intimation shall be given to them by contractor:- (a) (b) (c) When the timber is planed and cut to sizes and made ready before framing. When an article is ready in all respect except finishing. After an article is finished and is ready for delivery at the place mentioned here-in- before. The contractor shall facilitate the visit of GE and/or E-I-C t o the contractor’s workshop/factory and also the workshop/factory of approved manufacturer where brand ed furniture items are being fabricated/ manufactured. Such inspections or approvals by the Engineer-in-C harge and/or GE or omission of any such inspection shall not however, absolve the contractor of his respon sibility of manufacturing and supplying the articles all in accordance with the contract provisions and as pe r approved samples. In case of any doubt about the quality of any of the materials proposed to be incorpor ated in steel/wooden/Branded furniture item, GE may get such material tested in an independent laborato ry and the cost of sampling, transportation and testing shall be borne by the contractor in such case if the test results do not meet the quality requirements. If the Contractor’s workshop is situated away from place of delivery or in an out station where it may not be possible for the Engineer-in-Charge to visit frequently, the contractor shall bring all articles to the place of delivery without finishing, which shall be carried out in the MES Furniture yard after the articles of furniture have been inspected and approved by the Engineer-in -Charge. 4. 4.1 4.2 SAMPLE OF MATERIAL Samples of materials to be used in making of furniture (Steel/Wo oden/Branded) listed in Bid shall conform to the samples kept in GE‟s office. Samples shall be produced by the contractor for approval of GE before incorporation of such materials in the furniture articles. In case of Branded furniture items, the samples of materials shall be accompanied by original manufacture’s letter d uly mentioning the make, brand specification of materials and the details of factory where item(s) would b e manufactured. The contractor is advised to inspect samples of the following materials before submitting his tender:- (a) (b) (c) (d) (e) (f) (g) (h) (j) 1st class seasoned Teak Wood Iron Mongery Fittings MS Conduit Pipe/MS Tube Plastic cane Plastic laminated sheet Ply wood Particle board: Commercial/Decorative type/Pr e-laminated Nylon Newar (Virgin Quality, V-Shaped Knitting, Colour: As approved by GE). Block board Vene ered/un-veneered He will be deemed to have full knowledge there of whether he inspects them or not. The se samples are displayed in the office of the GE and shall remain open for inspection during office hours o n working days. The materials to be provided by the contractor must strictly conform to these samples. 5. SAMPLE OF FURNITURE ARTICLE 5.1 On acceptance of tender the contractor shall supply within the shortes t possible period not exceeding 30 days of the receipt of supply order from the GE, an unpolished sample o f each article of furniture, at the office of GE or where directed by him for his inspection. Time taken for the

manufacture and approval of the sample shall be deemed to be included in the period of completion indica ted in Schedule “A”. The cost of carriage of the sample shall be borne by the contractor. The samples and supplies submitted by the contractor shall be examined by the Garrison Engineer and their acceptance/rej ection with reasons thereof shall be communicated to the contractor. The contractor shall have no extensi on of time or any other claim whatsoever arising out due to rejection of samples/supplies for not adhering t o the contract specifications 5.2 The approved samples shall be labelled, signed and dated by the contract or and GE and kept in the furniture store yard. All supplies made subsequently shall be strictly in conformit y with the approved samples. The samples shall comply in all respect with the specifications given in the c ontract agreement. Finished samples shall be produced for approval before taking the bulk. 5.3 The appro ved samples of items shall be handed over after all supplies are complete. The samples of furniture items will be part of the supplies of respective items under Schedule “A”. 6. SIZES AND DIMENSIONS OF ARTICLE S 6.1 Sizes and dimensions as shown on respective drawing indicate finished size/dimension and no tolera nce thereto shall be allowed. In case of steel articles, unless otherwise specified in the relevant Indian Sta ndard referred to in particular specifications, which shall take precedence over this clause, the tolerance t o the extent referred to therein shall be admissible. However, in case of timber a tolerance of + 1.50 mm f or wrought faces may be allowed when the same is not to be fixed within the frame. No tolerance in case o f timber shall be allowed when the same is fixed within steel frame. 7.0 IDENTIFICATION TABS/LABELS 7.1 The contractor shall fix aluminium/tin tab of suitable size to each article of furniture supplied by him. Tabs shall be fixed to wooden furniture using brass screws of suitable size. Tabs to steel articles shall be fixed b y riveting or welding as approved by GE. The tab shall bear the name of contractor/supplier and contract n umber. The tab shall be fixed at a spot not directly visible, to be decided by the Engineer-in-Charge. The c ost of the same shall be deemed to be included in the unit rate of the article. Branded furniture articles sha ll bear the factory‟s name and lot number of the manufacturer. 8. VALIDITY OF TENDER 8.1 The tender sha ll remain open for acceptance for a period of sixty days from the date on which tender are due to be submi tted. 9. SEASONING OF WOOD 9.1 All timber required for the work shall be well seasoned and moisture co ntent shall not exceed 12%. The contractor shall produce necessary certificate to this effect. Production of such certificate shall, however, not absolve the contractor’s responsibility to ensure that moisture content of timber used in manufacturing the furniture is kept within the specified limit. The moisture content be pr esent, percentage over dry weight of timber. 10. EMPLOYMENT OF PERSONNEL BY CONTRACTOR 10.1 The contractor shall employ only Indian Nationals after verification of their antecedents and loyalty. Attention o f the Contractor is also drawn to condition 18 of IAFW-1815(Z)-General Conditions of Contract in this conne ction. 11. TIME OF DELIVERY 11.1 Time mentioned in Bid includes the time required for procurement, man ufacturing and approval of samples and delivery of furniture supply complete. 14. INDIAN STANDARDS 16. 1 Wherever any reference is made to any IS in the particular specifications, drawing etc, it means the lates t edition with all amendments current on the date of issue of the tender documents. Where, however, the I ndia Standard of certain materials have not been issued/finalized by the Bureau of India Standard, the mat erials shall comply with relevant British Standard Specifications(BSS). The contractor shall be deemed to h ave considered such requirements in the tender documents. 16.2 Materials bearing ISI certification mark s hall be given preference over those not bearing such marks. In case materials not bearing such mark are u sed contractor shall produce certificate from the manufacturer that their materials are conforming to relev ant IS. 17. ACCEPTANCE OF MATERIAL :- The contractor is required to deliver the furniture at the MES Furni ture Yard of GE complete in all respect for acceptance. Rejected articles shall be removed from the site im mediately. The contractor has to make his own arrangements for storage of rejected article and carry out necessary rectification of defects. 18 . SECURITY OF CLASSIFIED DOCUMENTS 18.1 Contractors special att ention is drawn to condition 3 of General conditions of contract IAFW 1815(Z). The contractor shall not com municate any classified information regarding the works either to sub-contractor or other without prior app roval of the Engineer-in-Charge. The Contractor shall also not make copies of the designs, drawing and oth er documents furnished to him in respect of works and he shall return all documents on the completion of the work or the earlier determination of the contractor. 18.2 The contractor shall alongwith final bill attach a receipt from the Engineer-in-Charge in respect of his having returned the classified documents as per co ndition 3 of General Conditions of contract (IAFW-1815-Z). 22. DRAWINGS The furniture drawings uploaded in ATC shall form part of the contract and are as per the guidelines issued by E-in-C’s Branch. 23. TAKING OVER OF FURNITURE A Board of Officers shall be ordered by the Accepting Officer to determine the quality /standard of materials and workmanship of furniture items/articles supplied by the Contractor as enumerat ed in Schedule “A” (BOQ) which shall inspect the items/articles at respective furniture yards before items/articles taken over by the department. The items inspected/passed by the Board shall only be taken on charge for payment. The item(s) rejected by the Board will be immediately returned to the Contractor f or replacement. Completion certificate shall be issued by GE only after verification of items/articles by BO O and after the contractor has supplied all the furniture to units under the maintenance of as directed by G E under the arrangement of contractor only. 24. KEY SPECIFICATIONS Brief specifications of materials/fittin gs/fixtures/finishes etc related to each item of furniture are given in Key Specifications which shall be follo wed. In case of any discrepancy the key specification shall take precedence and following points shall be n oted for strict compliance during execution:- (i) Uniformity of colour and texture of wooden/steel furniture i tems to be maintained with internal colour/texture. The same should match with the colour and texture of

inbuilt furniture. Necessary coordination needs to be carried out in this regard. (ii) Joints wooden furniture should be strong and made water tight by using good quality glue/adhesives. (iii) (iv) Screws/nails should not project out of the furnished surfaces. Edging/leaping to be polished/painted with the matching colour a nd should be in alignment of furniture surfaces. (v) The joints should not be hungry and shall be fine/smoot h grinding to be provided to the steel furniture. (vi) (vii) Drawers and shutters shall move/open smoothly. All the keys in duplicate/triplicate will be handed over to the users. (viii) PVC leg shoe should be of good q uality. (ix) All steel furniture shall be given powder coated paint except mentioned other wise in Drg/key s pecification. (x) (xi) 25. All latches/locks should be smooth functioning. All metallic items shall be rust free. Bills/Challans :- (i) Contractor shall be required to submit the address of the premises where the furniture u nder the contract shall be manufactured (all types of furniture). (ii) The Branded furniture shall be manufa ctured in main manufacturer’s premises/factory only and not in any dealer’s premises. (iii) Furniture and manufacturing materials shall be inspected by Engineer-in charge/board of officers at different stages of m anufacturing in the premises/factory of main manufacturer. (iv) Furniture items shall bear the factory’s na me and lot number of the manufacturer. (v) The contractor shall submit his own bill(s)/challan(s) well as th e original excise duty paid bill(s) of the branded furniture items’ manufacturer. 26. The approved samples shall be labelled with glued paper signed by the contractor and GE. All subsequent supplies shall be strictl y in conformity with the approved samples. PARTICULAR SPECIFICATIONS (PART –I) 1. 1.1. SCOPE OF CONT RACT This contract comprises manufacture and supply of furniture articles detailed in Schedule ‘A’ all as s hown on drawings and described in the Particular Specifications and in Key Specifications. These document s are complementary to one another and shall be read in conjunction with each other. 2 Materials : (a) Gen eral (i) All materials to be supplied by the contractor for incorporation in the work shall be new and confor ming with the quality as per samples displayed at Furniture Stores Yard of the GE. (ii) The Government doe s not undertake any responsibility to provide any facilities such as permits, priorities, etc for the procurem ent of materials or for electric power etc for contractor’s plant and machinery. 3. Unless otherwise specifie d, planks used for large surfaces such as table tops, shelves, panels etc. upto 30 cm wide shall be in single width. For surfaces wider than 30cm, more than one plank each not less than 20cm wide but of equal widt h may be used. Where the total width of table tops, shelves, panels etc. does not permit use of planks 20 c m wide or more, the GE may allow use of planks of lesser width but of equal width or to use only one of the planks of lesser width(but not less than 15cm) to make the total width of table tops, shelves and panels. Th e GE’s decision in this regard shall be final and binding. Wherever two or more planks are used these shall be jointed together with ploughed and tongued or tongue and grooved at the discretion of the contractor. No piecing in the length shall be allowed. 4 NAILS/SCREWS/BAMBOO DOWEL PINS 5.1 Nails shall not be us ed where screws are to be used. Dowel pins for joints shall be of matured, dry and solid bamboo. Pins shall be provided for joints such as those in frames of charpoys, beds. Iron mongery of steel shall be fixed with s teel screws of appropriate size and iron mongery of brass shall be fixed with brass screws of appropriate si ze. Iron mongery of aluminium shall be fixed with chromium plated steel screws of appropriate size. The sc rews in other situations shall be of material as specified or indicated on the drawings. The screws shall be of ‘Nettle-fold’ brand. The screws shall be driven home with screw driver and shall not be hammered in. 5 PLY WOOD/PARTICLE BOARD/BLOCK BOARD/MDF BOARD ETC. (a) PLYWOOD (i) (ii) (b) COMMERCIAL(NON- DECORATIVE) PLY WOOD: These shall be of commercial quality, grade BWR, type ‘ A’ conforming to IS:303 -1989. Thickness of ply wood shall be as indicated in respective drawings. Wherever thickness of ply wood is not shown in drawings or specified elsewhere, it shall be considered as 6mm thick. DECORATIVE PLY WO OD: These shall be type -1 quality, grade BWR, conforming to IS:1328. Decorative plywood shall have dec orative veneers (veneers as specified) on one or both faces as specified. The adhesive for bonding of vene ers shall be synthetic resin adhesive conforming to IS:848 1974. The plywood shall be ISI marked. BLOCK BOARD: Unless specified otherwise block boards shall conform to the requirements of IS:1656-2004 and sh all be grade 1 quality, exterior grade and shall be Decorative type(one or both faces) or commercial type a s indicated or specified. The block Board shall be ISI marked. (c) PARTICLE BOARD: Unless specified otherw ise particle boards shall conform to the requirements of IS:3087-2005, specifications for wood particle boar d(medium density) for general purposes. Adhesive used for bonding of particles shall be BWR type phenol- formaldehyde synthetic resin adhesive. The particle board shall be exterior grade with solid core, flat pres sed, single layer type. Decorative particle board shall conform to the requirements of IS:3097-2006 and sh all be exterior grade with solid core , flat pressed, single layer type, ISI marked and shall be grade I quality , These shall have decorative choice veneers on one or both faces as specified or directed. (d) PRE-LAMINA TED PARTICLE BOARD: Unless specified otherwise melamine Faced pre-laminated particle boards shall con form to the requirements of IS:12823-1990 (Reaffirmed 2005). These shall be type 1 quality, exterior grad e. Adhesive used for bonding of particles shall be BWR type phenol-formaldehyde synthetic resin adhesive. The pre laminated particle board shall be ISI marked on the edge. (e) MEDIUM DENSITY FIBRE BOARD :MD F board where shown on the drawing or as specified to be provided as per Key Specification shall conform to IS:14587.Grade of Board shall be exterior grade phenol formaldehyde synthetic resin bonded designate EGSB. (f) Where plywood, particle board, block board, MDF board of the thickness specified or indicated on the drawings are not manufactured or are not available, then the next higher thickness as manufactured as may be available shall be used, without any extra cost to the Govt. Particle board, block board, plywood w herever required shall be in one piece. 6. 7. 8. 9. FITTINGS : a. All fittings shall be strictly in accordance wi

th the sample kept in the furniture stores yard of the GE. The contractor shall submit samples of all iron m ongery of steel, aluminium (anodized) or brass for approval by the GE and shall obtain his written approval before incorporation in the work. b. Unless otherwise mentioned in the Key Specification drawer and cup-b oard locks shall be of brass body with 2/3 lever with two Nos. steel/brass keys and shall be fixed with brass screws. c. Unless otherwise mentioned in the Key Specification hasps and staples shall be of safety pattern mild steel chromium plated of size indicated on the drawing or in the Key Specification. Where size is not i ndicated it shall be of 75mm size. d. Hinges brass wherever specified shall be made out of sheet metal of fi ne cast brass with steel pins. e. Unless otherwise shown on drawing knob shall be of 40mm diameter of chr omium plated steel of heavy weight quality. f. Magnetic catch where indicated on the drawing/specified sh all be as approved by the GE. STEEL AND IRON WORK All steel required for the work shall be contractor’s s upply and comply with Indian standard relevant items of furniture. PGI SHEET: Plain galvanised iron sheet wherever specified/shown on drawing are finished size and shall be conform to IS:277-2003.These shall be obtained from any of the manufacturers mentioned in the LIST OF MAKES/MANUFACTURERS given in the te nder. WORKMANSHIP: a) a. GENERAL: The work shall be executed in sound and workman-like manner. The workmanship shall be of the highest standard in accordance with good and approved trade practice. The G E shall be the sole judge to decide as to whether or not the workmanship is as aforesaid. b) WOOD WORK : All wood works unless otherwise stated/shown on drawings, shall be properly wrought on all faces and fra med and shall hold the full finished thickness as indicated in the drawings. c) The work ‘framed’ as applied to wood work shall be understood as including all the best known methods for jointing wood work together by mortice and tennon and dovetailed joints to fit properly without any wedging, filling or making up. d) All wood work which is to be polished/painted shall be finished to smooth true and clean surface with stand p aper of suitable grade. Edges or corner where required shall be slightly rounded. e) All framed jointing in wood work except tongued and grooved or rebated boarding shall be put together with ‘Fevicol’, clamped and then joints primed. Tongued, grooved or rebated joints in joinery and boarding shall be Fevicoled and clamped when putting them together. d. All joints(except joints in panels) in wood work shall be either mo rtice and tennon or dovetailed and shall be framed so as to fit fully and truly with out wedging , filling or m aking up and made so as to be hidden from view. All joints before assembling shall be put together with gl ue. e. LIPPING TO EDGES OF BLOCK BOARD/PARTICE BOARD Lipping to edges of block boards where specif ied shall invariably be done with teak fillets of required sizes. The adhesive for fixing lipping to edged of bl ock board shall be will Fevicoal., or any other approved adhesive. In addition to gluing the lipping shall be screwed with suitable size of wood screws (counter sunk) and the counter sunk holes are cut and polished. 10. STEEL AND IRON WORK (a) All steel and iron work shall be prepared accurately to the dimension indic ated on the drawings and shall be forged clean, from anvil and finished with hammer, chisel and file. All ho les shall be drilled except in case of sheet iron which may be punched. Rivets shall be carefully shaped to ensure true bedding. Rivets head shall be formed with proper tools, unfinished heads shall not be accepte d. Fixing of iron work to wood work shall be done with screws subject to approval by the GE. (b) FINISHING TO FURNITURE: All articles of furniture shall be finished as indicated in the drawings or Key Specifications a nd as described below:- 11 PAINTING: All synthetic enamel paints and emulsion paints shall be of 1st qualit y manufac tured by the standard firm. The contractor shall inform the GE, within three weeks of the accept ance of the tender, the brand/ names of the manufacturers of paint proposed to be used in the work and s ubmit samples thereof to GE before their use in work and obtain prior approval of GE. Paints for priming co at, under coat and finishing coat shall be of the same brand. Tint of paint, if not mentioned in drgs/schedul e of finishes, shall be as approved by the GE. Pink primer shall be used on wooden surface and red oxide p rimer shall be used on steel surface. Concrete surface shall be applied with cement primer. The workmans hip shall be as under:- (a) All surfaces required to be painted shall be smoothened size and knotted and th en applied with priming coat, stopping and filling [filler coat] shall be done after priming coat and surface r ubbed down to a level and smooth surface and thereafter under coat and finishing coat shall be applied all as specified in clause 17.6 of MES Schedule Part-I. Steel and iron work shall be painted in the manner as sp ecified in clause 17.8 of MES Schedule Part-I. (b) All steel and wooden surfaces including wooden based su rfaces such as plywood, particle board etc shall be given two coats [under coat and finishing coat] of synth etic enamel paint.
